  const inside = roots.some(root => isUnderPath(full, safeRealpath(realpath, root)))
  if (!inside) throw new AcpError('cwd_denied', `acp: fs path ${full} is outside the session workspace`)
  return full
}

// ---- Child environment ----

/**
 * The agent is a peer process, not a DSH sub-agent: it inherits the host
 * environment exactly as a native tool would, and the agent's configured env
 * wins per key on top.
 */
export function childEnv(parent: NodeJS.ProcessEnv, extra: Record<string, string>): Record<string, string> {
  const out: Record<string, string> = {}
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(parent)) {
    if (v === undefined) continue
    out[k] = v
  }
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(extra)) out[k] = v
  return out
}

// ---- Model catalog (pure parsing of ACP `configOptions`) ----

/**
 * ACP categories are free-form UX hints, not identity. Qoder CN tags
 * `reasoning_effort` as `category: 'model'` (the spec means `thought_level`),
 * and nothing stops an agent from reusing a category for several options.
 * Slots are therefore assigned by `configId` first and category second, and a
 * same-category option NEVER replaces another option's slot: whatever loses
 * stays reachable through `extras` instead of silently becoming the model list.
 */
const EFFORT_OPTION_HINT = /effort|thinking|thought|reason/i

function isModelSelector(configId: string, name: string): boolean {
  return configId === 'model' || name.trim().toLowerCase() === 'model'
}

type CatalogSlot = 'model' | 'thought' | 'mode'

interface CatalogSlotCandidate {
  slot: CatalogSlot
  rank: number
  option: AcpCatalogOption
}

function catalogSlotFor(category: string | undefined, configId: string, name: string): Omit<CatalogSlotCandidate, 'option'> | undefined {
  const effortish = EFFORT_OPTION_HINT.test(configId) || EFFORT_OPTION_HINT.test(name)
  if (category === 'model') {
    // The option explicitly named `model` is the selector even when other
    // model-scoped options are present.
    if (isModelSelector(configId, name)) return { slot: 'model', rank: 3 }
    // A model-scoped effort is mislabelled, not a model: route it to the
    // thought chip when no real `thought_level` option is published.
    if (effortish) return { slot: 'thought', rank: 1 }
    // An unknown model-scoped select: a last-resort selector only.
    return { slot: 'model', rank: 1 }
  }
  if (category === 'thought_level') return { slot: 'thought', rank: 3 }
  if (category === 'mode') return { slot: 'mode', rank: 2 }
  // `model_config` is where the spec puts model-dependent knobs (effort,
  // context size); only the effort-shaped ones have a dedicated control.
  if (category === 'model_config' && effortish) return { slot: 'thought', rank: 1 }
  return undefined
}

/**
 * Extract select options from a raw ACP `configOptions` payload.
 *
 * `model`, `thought_level` and `mode` get dedicated slots. Every OTHER select
 * with at least one choice lands in `extras` (deduped by `configId`, last
 * definition wins) — that is what the composer's advanced base lists and sets.
 * Tolerant by design: unknown categories, boolean options, grouped choices,
 * missing `name`, and the legacy `id` field (pre-spec agents) are all handled;
 * anything unusable is skipped silently.
 */
export function parseCatalogOptions(configOptions: unknown): AcpAgentCatalog {
  const out: AcpAgentCatalog = {}
  if (!Array.isArray(configOptions)) return out
  const definitions: AcpCatalogOption[] = []
  const candidates: CatalogSlotCandidate[] = []
  for (const raw of configOptions) {
    if (typeof raw !== 'object' || raw === null) continue
    const row = raw as Record<string, unknown>
    const category = typeof row.category === 'string' ? row.category : undefined
    const configIdRaw = row.configId ?? row.id
    if (typeof configIdRaw !== 'string' && typeof configIdRaw !== 'number') continue
    const configId = String(configIdRaw)
    if (configId === '') continue
    const choices: NonNullable<AcpAgentCatalog['model']>['choices'] = []
    collectCatalogChoices(row.options, choices)
    const name = typeof row.name === 'string' && row.name !== '' ? row.name : configId
    // A boolean toggle has no `options` at all; its current value is a JSON
    // boolean. It is encoded as 'true' / 'false' so the catalog stays
    // string-typed for every existing reader, and carries `kind` so the
    // composer renders a checkbox instead of a select.
    const booleanKind = row.type === 'boolean'
      || (typeof row.currentValue === 'boolean' && choices.length === 0)
    const option: AcpCatalogOption = {
      configId,
      name,
      ...(booleanKind ? { kind: 'boolean' as const } : {}),
      currentValue: booleanKind
        ? row.currentValue === true || row.currentValue === 'true'
          ? 'true'
          : row.currentValue === false || row.currentValue === 'false' ? 'false' : null
        : typeof row.currentValue === 'string' && row.currentValue !== '' ? row.currentValue : null,
      choices,
    }
    definitions.push(option)
    // A toggle is never a model / thought / mode SELECT: those controls pick
    // among choices. It belongs to the advanced base, where it is a checkbox.
    if (booleanKind) continue
    const slot = catalogSlotFor(category, configId, name)
    if (slot !== undefined) candidates.push({ ...slot, option })
  }
  const winnerIds = new Set<string>()
  for (const slot of ['model', 'thought', 'mode'] as const) {
    let winner: CatalogSlotCandidate | undefined
    for (const candidate of candidates) {
      if (candidate.slot !== slot) continue
      if (winner === undefined || candidate.rank > winner.rank) {
        winner = candidate
      } else if (candidate.rank === winner.rank && candidate.option.configId === winner.option.configId) {
        // The same option redefined later in one answer: the last definition
        // is the current one.
        winner = candidate
      }
    }
    if (winner === undefined) continue
    out[slot] = winner.option
    winnerIds.add(winner.option.configId)
  }
  // Choice-less options have nothing to pick; they would render an empty
  // section in the advanced menu, so they stay out of the catalog entirely —
  // except a boolean, whose whole point is that it has no choices. Anything
  // that lost a slot race is still a real, settable option: keep it here.
  const extras = new Map<string, AcpCatalogOption>()
  for (const option of definitions) {
    if (winnerIds.has(option.configId)) continue
    if (option.choices.length > 0 || option.kind === 'boolean') extras.set(option.configId, option)
  }
  if (extras.size > 0) out.extras = [...extras.values()]
  return out
}

/**
 * Whether a payload names ONE model selector without relying on category
 * alone. When an agent publishes several `category: 'model'` options and none
 * is explicitly the `model` id, the category is not trustworthy enough to
 * reject the user's pick — callers must fail open instead of reporting
 * `model_unavailable`.
 */
export function hasUnambiguousModelSelector(configOptions: unknown): boolean {
  if (!Array.isArray(configOptions)) return true
  let scoped = 0
  let explicit = false
  for (const raw of configOptions) {
    if (typeof raw !== 'object' || raw === null) continue
    const row = raw as Record<string, unknown>
    if (row.category !== 'model') continue
    const configIdRaw = row.configId ?? row.id
    if (typeof configIdRaw !== 'string' && typeof configIdRaw !== 'number') continue
    const configId = String(configIdRaw)
    if (configId === '') continue
    scoped += 1
    const name = typeof row.name === 'string' ? row.name : ''
    if (isModelSelector(configId, name)) explicit = true
  }
  return explicit || scoped <= 1
}

/**
 * Fold one per-session option answer's SHAPE into an agent-level catalog.
 *
 * `session/set_config_option` answers are often the ONLY place an agent
 * publishes how its option set changes with the model — opencode offers
 * `thought_level` (`effort`) just for models with variants and never
 * re-notifies after a client-driven set — and the composer's thought chip is
 * driven by the agent-level catalog. What is agent knowledge there is the
 * SHAPE (which slots exist, which choices they offer); `currentValue` is not:
 * in a per-session answer it is that session's pick, and promoting it would
 * turn one conversation's choice into `reasoning.defaultEffort` for every
 * other one. A merged slot therefore keeps the catalog's known current value
 * while the observed choices still offer it, and `null` ("the agent's own
 * default") otherwise. Slots the answer does not mention are left alone — a
 * different model may still offer them.
 */
export function mergeCatalogShape(existing: AcpAgentCatalog | undefined, observed: AcpAgentCatalog): AcpAgentCatalog {
  const out: AcpAgentCatalog = {}
  const merge = (prev: AcpCatalogOption | undefined, next: AcpCatalogOption): AcpCatalogOption => {
    const kept = prev?.currentValue ?? null
    return {
      configId: next.configId,
      name: next.name,
      ...(next.kind === 'boolean' ? { kind: 'boolean' as const } : {}),
      // A boolean has no choices to test `kept` against; it keeps the
      // catalog's known default like any other slot (the answer's value is
      // still one session's truth, not the agent's).
      currentValue: kept !== null && (next.choices.length === 0 || next.choices.some(choice => choice.value === kept)) ? kept : null,
      choices: next.choices,
    }
  }
  for (const slot of ['model', 'thought', 'mode'] as const) {
    const prev = existing?.[slot]
    const next = observed[slot]
    if (next === undefined) {
      if (prev !== undefined) out[slot] = prev
      continue
    }
    out[slot] = merge(prev, next)
  }
  // Extras merge by configId: observed entries refresh their shape, entries
  // only the earlier answer knew survive (another model may still offer them).
  const extras = new Map<string, AcpCatalogOption>()
  for (const option of existing?.extras ?? []) extras.set(option.configId, option)
  for (const option of observed.extras ?? []) extras.set(option.configId, merge(extras.get(option.configId), option))
  if (extras.size > 0) out.extras = [...extras.values()]
  return out
}

/**
 * Size ceiling for one `configOptions` answer to be believed. Normal answers
 * are a few KB (a 500-model catalog is well under this); beyond it the agent is
 * misbehaving and absorbing/persisting it would turn every notification into
 * an unbounded write.
 */
export const MAX_CONFIG_OPTIONS_BYTES = 1 << 20

/**
 * Whether a `configOptions` answer may overwrite known state.
 *
 * An EMPTY (or absent) answer is a non-answer: observed agents return
 * `configOptions: []` in intermediate states, and treating that as "this agent
 * now has no options" would wipe a perfectly good catalog and session
 * snapshot for a state that passes (the rule OmniTerm settles on for the same
 * observation — empty sets never overwrite the last known state). Oversized
 * answers are dropped for the same reason: see {@link MAX_CONFIG_OPTIONS_BYTES}.
 */
export function usableConfigOptions(configOptions: unknown): configOptions is unknown[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(configOptions) || configOptions.length === 0) return false
  return JSON.stringify(configOptions).length <= MAX_CONFIG_OPTIONS_BYTES
}

/** Flatten select `options` (plain values or `SessionConfigSelectGroup`s) into choices, deduped by value. */
function collectCatalogChoices(options: unknown, out: NonNullable<AcpAgentCatalog['model']>['choices']): void {
  if (!Array.isArray(options)) return
  for (const raw of options) {
    if (typeof raw !== 'object' || raw === null) continue
    const row = raw as Record<string, unknown>
    if (Array.isArray(row.options)) {
      // Grouped form: flatten the inner values, borrowing the group label as fallback description.
      for (const inner of row.options) {
        if (typeof inner !== 'object' || inner === null) continue
        pushCatalogChoice(inner as Record<string, unknown>, out, typeof row.name === 'string' ? row.name : undefined)
      }
      continue
    }
    pushCatalogChoice(row, out)
  }
}

function pushCatalogChoice(row: Record<string, unknown>, out: NonNullable<AcpAgentCatalog['model']>['choices'], groupLabel?: string): void {
  const value = row.value
  if (typeof value !== 'string' || value === '') return
  if (out.some(c => c.value === value)) return
  const description = typeof row.description === 'string' && row.description !== '' ? row.description : groupLabel
  out.push({
    value,
    name: typeof row.name === 'string' && row.name !== '' ? row.name : value,
    ...(description !== undefined ? { description } : {}),
    // The group label is kept on its own field (commonly the vendor) so the
    // settings panel can filter by it even when the choice has its own text.
    // Only real ACP `SessionConfigSelectGroup` labels land here — no guessing:
    // any vendor may serve another vendor's models, so synthesizing buckets
    // from name prefixes or value paths would misclassify.
    ...(groupLabel !== undefined ? { group: groupLabel } : {}),
  })
}

/**
 * Split an adapter model id into its agent id and optional model choice.
 * `@` is the separator because agent ids are restricted to `[a-z0-9._-]`.
 */
export function splitAdapterModelId(model: string): { agentId: string; choice?: string } {
  const at = model.indexOf('@')
  if (at <= 0) return { agentId: model }
  return { agentId: model.slice(0, at), choice: model.slice(at + 1) }
}

/** Inverse of {@link splitAdapterModelId} for variant entries. */
export function buildAdapterModelId(agentId: string, choice: string): string {
  return `${agentId}@${choice}`
}

// ---- ACP tool-call notifications → DSH tool-call stream chunks ----

/**
 * Tool activity as REAL `tool-call` blocks, one driver step per tool activity.
 *
 * The ordering problem (docs/acp-convergence.md §1.7) is solved by SEGMENTING
 * the turn, not by prose: the adapter ends its stream when a tool-bearing
 * segment has a card and the next non-tool event arrives, the host settles the
 * assistant message, executes the card (the guard's virtual tool answers with
 * the agent's real output from the shared registry), and its agent loop then
 * proposes the continuation step — whose stream() call resumes reading the SAME
 * in-flight `session/prompt` from the transcript cursor. Cards therefore sit
 * between two assistant messages, exactly like a native multi-step turn.
 */

/**
 * One ACP tool call, narrowed to what the Chat plane's tool-call renderer shows.
 *
 * `callId` is the ACP `toolCallId` — it is the only identity the agent gives, and
 * the Chat renderer uses it to group a call with its updates. `name` is the
 * agent's own label (`title`, falling back to nothing at all: the renderer shows
 * the call id when a name is missing). `argsRaw` accumulates whatever the agent
 * chose to disclose — ACP has no mandatory arguments field, so an agent that
 * sends none simply produces an empty block, which is honest.
 */
export interface AcpToolCallSnapshot {
  callId: string
  name: string
  /** Accumulated argument text (ACP has no fixed vocabulary for it). */
  argsRaw: string
}

/** A delta of tool-call content, folded into the open snapshot. */
export type AcpToolCallDelta =
  | { kind: 'name'; name: string }
  | { kind: 'args'; text: string }

/**
 * The argument text an ACP tool-call notification carries, if any.
 *
 * Accepts the spellings seen in the wild (`rawInput` / `arguments` as a string,
 * an object, or an ARRAY of inputs) and refuses to invent one: an agent that
 * sends no arguments gets `''`, which renders as an empty card rather than a
 * fabricated placeholder.
 */
export function acpToolCallArgsOf(update: Record<string, unknown>): string {
  for (const key of ['rawInput', 'arguments'] as const) {
    const value = update[key]
    if (typeof value === 'string') {
      if (value !== '') return value
      continue
    }
    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
      if (value.length > 0) return jsonOf(value)
      continue
    }
    if (typeof value === 'object' && value !== null) return jsonOf(value)
  }
  return ''
}

/**
 * Fold one ACP `tool_call` notification into a snapshot.
 *
 * `rawInput` / `arguments` are accepted when present: some agents send structured
 * input, and a tool card that cannot show its arguments is half a card. Anything
 * else is ignored — a tool call with only an id and a title is legal ACP.
 */
export function acpToolCallFromUpdate(update: Record<string, unknown>): AcpToolCallSnapshot | undefined {
  const callId = typeof update.toolCallId === 'string' ? update.toolCallId.trim() : ''
  if (callId === '') return undefined
  const name = typeof update.title === 'string' ? update.title : ''
  return { callId, name, argsRaw: acpToolCallArgsOf(update) }
}

/**
 * Fold one ACP `tool_call_update` into an open snapshot, in place.
 *
 * ACP updates carry FULL replacement snapshots (`rawInput` restated in whole on
 * every change), while the host's accumulator CONCATENATES `argumentsDelta` —
 * so the deltas produced here are the extension suffix only, and the snapshot
 * itself always moves to the latest known text (the closing `block-end` frame
 * replaces the block wholesale, which is what makes a non-extension update
 * land correctly in the settled card).
 */
export function acpToolCallDelta(
  snapshot: AcpToolCallSnapshot,
  update: Record<string, unknown>,
): AcpToolCallDelta[] {
  const deltas: AcpToolCallDelta[] = []
  const title = update.title
  if (typeof title === 'string' && title !== '' && title !== snapshot.name) {
    deltas.push({ kind: 'name', name: title })
    snapshot.name = title
  }
  const input = acpToolCallArgsOf(update)
  if (input !== '') {
    const suffix = extensionSuffixOf(snapshot.argsRaw, input)
    if (suffix !== '') deltas.push({ kind: 'args', text: suffix })
    snapshot.argsRaw = input
  } else if (snapshot.argsRaw === '') {
    const text = updateContentToText(update.content)
    if (text !== '') {
      deltas.push({ kind: 'args', text })
      snapshot.argsRaw = text
    }
  }
  return deltas
}

/**
 * The part of `next` that extends `previous` — the only thing a concatenating
 * delta consumer can express. A replacement (the agent rewrote its input) has
 * no honest delta; the caller updates the snapshot regardless and lets the
 * closing snapshot tell the truth.
 */
function extensionSuffixOf(previous: string, next: string): string {
  if (previous === '') return next
  return next.startsWith(previous) ? next.slice(previous.length) : ''
}

/**
 * Whether this request is the CONTINUATION step of a turn whose previous step
 * settled with tool-call blocks — which is exactly what the ACP agent's display
 * cards are. The host agent-loop starts a next step whenever the settled
 * assistant message contains `tool-call` blocks, feeding it the staged tool
 * results: the request's message list then has `tool`-sourced messages AFTER
 * the last user-sourced one. A fresh prompt never does (the person's new words
 * are the last message); history from earlier turns sits before the new user
 * text, so it cannot trip this.
 *
 * The adapter answers such a step by resuming the SAME in-flight ACP prompt
 * from the transcript cursor instead of sending a new one (see
 * `BridgeManager.streamPrompt` and docs/acp-convergence.md §1.7).
 */
export function isAcpToolContinuation(messages: readonly {
  source?: { kind?: string }
}[]): boolean {
  let lastTool = -1
  for (let i = 0; i < messages.length; i += 1) {
    if (messages[i]?.source?.kind === 'tool') lastTool = i
  }
  if (lastTool < 0) return false
  for (let i = lastTool + 1; i < messages.length; i += 1) {
    const kind = messages[i]?.source?.kind
    // A source-less message counts as user input — the same convention
    // `selectForwardPrompt` uses for hand-built requests.
    if (kind === undefined || kind === 'user') return false
  }
  return true
}

/** One structured edit as plain text: its path, then `-`/`+` lines with three lines of context. */
export interface AcpDiffPayload {
  path: string
  oldText: string | null
  newText: string
}

/** One folded piece of a tool call's `content`. */
export type AcpContentRow =
  | { kind: 'text'; text: string }
  /** Structured edits are kept apart: flattening them to `diff <path>` throws away the review. */
  | { kind: 'diff'; diff: AcpDiffPayload }
  /** A kind we cannot render. `json` carries the whole item, so nothing the agent sent is lost. */
  | { kind: 'other'; label: string; json: string }

/**
 * Fold one ACP tool-call content item, preserving everything.
 *
 * The caller decides how to render a `text` / `diff` / `other` row; the one rule
 * here is that no shape may vanish. ACP agents in the wild send kinds beyond the
 * spec's `content` / `diff` / `terminal` (observations, images, links, custom
 * rows), and an item we do not understand is still something the agent said —
 * it rides along as `other` with its full JSON rather than disappearing.
 */
export function acpContentRows(content: unknown): AcpContentRow[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(content)) return []
  const out: AcpContentRow[] = []
  for (const item of content) {
    if (typeof item !== 'object' || item === null) {
      if (typeof item === 'string' && item !== '') out.push({ kind: 'text', text: item })
      continue
    }
    const row = item as Record<string, unknown>
    const type = typeof row.type === 'string' ? row.type : ''
    if (type === 'content') {
      const inner = row.content as Record<string, unknown> | undefined
      if (typeof inner === 'string') {
        out.push({ kind: 'text', text: inner })
      } else if (inner?.type === 'text' && typeof inner.text === 'string') {
        out.push({ kind: 'text', text: inner.text })
      } else if (inner?.type === 'diff') {
        const path = typeof inner.path === 'string' ? inner.path : ''
        out.push({
          kind: 'diff',
          diff: { path, oldText: typeof inner.oldText === 'string' ? inner.oldText : null, newText: typeof inner.newText === 'string' ? inner.newText : '' },
        })
      } else {
        out.push({ kind: 'other', label: String(inner?.type ?? 'content'), json: jsonOf(item) })
      }
      continue
    }
    if (type === 'diff' && typeof row.path === 'string' && typeof row.newText === 'string') {
      out.push({ kind: 'diff', diff: { path: row.path, oldText: typeof row.oldText === 'string' ? row.oldText : null, newText: row.newText } })
      continue
    }
    out.push({ kind: 'other', label: type === '' ? 'content' : type, json: jsonOf(item) })
  }
  return out
}

/**
 * The plain text of one tool payload: text as-is, diffs as a per-file header
 * plus its removed/added lines (`-`/`+`), other kinds as their full JSON. This
 * replaces the old `[diff path]` / `[terminal id]` placeholders — those names
 * the block and drop everything else the agent said.
 *
 * It doubles as what the guard's virtual tools answer the host loop with, so
 * both the card and the executed result read the same thing.
 */
export function updateContentToText(content: unknown): string {
  return acpContentRows(content).map(row => {
    if (row.kind === 'text') return row.text
    if (row.kind === 'diff') return formatAcpDiff(row.diff)
    return `${row.label} ${row.json}`
  }).join('\n')
}

/** One structured edit as readable text: `path`, then `-`/`+` lines plus unchanged context. */
export function formatAcpDiff(diff: AcpDiffPayload): string {
  const oldLines = splitLines(diff.oldText)
  const newLines = splitLines(diff.newText)
  let head = 0
  while (head < oldLines.length && head < newLines.length && oldLines[head] === newLines[head]) head++
  let tail = 0
  while (
    tail < oldLines.length - head
    && tail < newLines.length - head
    && oldLines[oldLines.length - 1 - tail] === newLines[newLines.length - 1 - tail]
  ) tail++
  const lines: string[] = [diff.path]
  for (let i = Math.max(0, head - 3); i < head; i++) lines.push(`  ${oldLines[i] ?? ''}`)
  for (let i = head; i < oldLines.length - tail; i++) lines.push(`- ${oldLines[i] ?? ''}`)
  for (let i = head; i < newLines.length - tail; i++) lines.push(`+ ${newLines[i] ?? ''}`)
  for (let i = oldLines.length - tail; i < oldLines.length; i++) lines.push(`  ${oldLines[i] ?? ''}`)
  return lines.join('\n')
}

function splitLines(text: string | null): string[] {
  if (text === null || text === '') return []
  return text.endsWith('\n') ? text.slice(0, -1).split('\n') : text.split('\n')
}

/** JSON text of a value; a non-serializable value falls back to its string form rather than throwing. */
function jsonOf(value: unknown): string {
  try {
    return JSON.stringify(value) ?? String(value)
  } catch {
    return String(value)
  }
}

/** Cap on one tool call's raw notification. Large enough for big `content` arrays; the cut is marked. */
export const ACP_TOOL_RAW_MAX = 256_000

/** Pretty-printed JSON of an agent message, truncated only at {@link ACP_TOOL_RAW_MAX}. */
export function dumpJson(value: unknown): string {
  let text: string
  try {
    text = JSON.stringify(value, null, 2) ?? String(value)
  } catch {
    text = String(value)
  }
  return text.length > ACP_TOOL_RAW_MAX
    ? `${text.slice(0, ACP_TOOL_RAW_MAX)}\n… [truncated ${String(text.length - ACP_TOOL_RAW_MAX)} chars]`
    : text
}

// ---- host request → forwarded ACP prompt ----

/** Notification kinds that are routine state, not content: they update the session view and nothing else. */
export const BOOKKEEPING_UPDATES: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set([
  'current_mode_update',
  'config_option_update',
  'available_commands_update',
  'session_info_update',
  'usage_update',
])

/**
 * Human-readable text of an ACP notification this build has no card of its own
 * for. The text is what the native chat stream shows and what the guard answers
 * the host loop's execution of that card with, so it must carry the payload —
 * a plan's entries, an unknown kind's whole JSON — rather than only a name.
 *
 * The routine bookkeeping kinds (`current_mode_update`, `available_commands_update`,
 * and the rest of `BOOKKEEPING_UPDATES`) never reach this function on the live
 * path: `streamPrompt` drops them before it announces a kind inline — it is the
 * only caller. The two branches below that name them are a defensive fallback
 * for a direct caller, NOT a live route into the chat stream.
 */
export function describeUnhandledUpdate(kind: string, update: Record<string, unknown>): string {
  const label = kind === '' ? 'session update' : kind
  if (kind === 'plan') {
    const entries = Array.isArray(update.entries) ? update.entries : []
    if (entries.length === 0) return `${label}: (empty plan)`
    return entries.map(entry => {
      const row = (typeof entry === 'object' && entry !== null ? entry : {}) as Record<string, unknown>
      const status = typeof row.status === 'string' ? row.status : 'pending'
      const priority = typeof row.priority === 'string' ? ` [${row.priority}]` : ''
      return `[${status}]${priority} ${String(row.content ?? '')}`
    }).join('\n')
  }
  if (kind === 'current_mode_update' && typeof update.currentModeId === 'string') return `${label}: ${update.currentModeId}`
  if (kind === 'available_commands_update') {
    const commands = Array.isArray(update.availableCommands) ? update.availableCommands : []
    return commands.map(command => {
      const row = (typeof command === 'object' && command !== null ? command : {}) as Record<string, unknown>
      const name = typeof row.name === 'string' ? row.name : ''
      const description = typeof row.description === 'string' && row.description !== '' ? ` — ${row.description}` : ''
      return `${name}${description}`
    }).join('\n')
  }
  return `${label}\n${dumpJson(update)}`
}

/**
 * Outcome of picking the one message an ACP turn forwards.
 *
 * `no-user-input` is its own case, not an error: the host wakes a driver for
 * injected context too (goal/subagent/skill material), and that turn carries no
 * user intent to send anywhere.
 */
export interface PromptImageContent {
  type: 'image'
  data: string
  mimeType: string
  uri?: string
}

export interface PromptTextContent {
  type: 'text'
  text: string
}

export type PromptContentBlock = PromptTextContent | PromptImageContent

/** Helper: guess MIME type from file extension or URL */
export function guessImageMimeType(pathOrUrl?: string): string | undefined {
  if (!pathOrUrl) return undefined
  const clean = pathOrUrl.split('?')[0].split('#')[0].toLowerCase()
  if (clean.endsWith('.jpg') || clean.endsWith('.jpeg')) return 'image/jpeg'
  if (clean.endsWith('.png')) return 'image/png'
  if (clean.endsWith('.gif')) return 'image/gif'
  if (clean.endsWith('.webp')) return 'image/webp'
  if (clean.endsWith('.svg') || clean.endsWith('.svgz')) return 'image/svg+xml'
  if (clean.endsWith('.bmp')) return 'image/bmp'
  if (clean.endsWith('.ico')) return 'image/x-icon'
  if (clean.endsWith('.tiff') || clean.endsWith('.tif')) return 'image/tiff'
  if (clean.endsWith('.avif')) return 'image/avif'
  if (clean.endsWith('.heic')) return 'image/heic'
  if (clean.endsWith('.heif')) return 'image/heif'
  if (clean.endsWith('.apng')) return 'image/apng'
  return undefined
}

/** Helper: parse Data URI */
export function parseImageDataUrl(url: string): { data: string; mimeType: string } | undefined {
  if (!url.startsWith('data:')) return undefined
  const commaIdx = url.indexOf(',')
  if (commaIdx === -1) return undefined
  const header = url.slice(5, commaIdx)
  const raw = url.slice(commaIdx + 1).trim()
  const parts = header.split(';')
  const mimeType = parts[0] && parts[0].trim() !== '' ? parts[0].trim().toLowerCase() : 'image/png'
  if (!mimeType.startsWith('image/')) return undefined
  const isBase64 = parts.some(p => p.trim() === 'base64')
  let data: string
  if (isBase64) {
    data = raw.replace(/\s+/g, '')
  } else {
    try {
      const decoded = decodeURIComponent(raw)
      data = typeof Buffer !== 'undefined' ? Buffer.from(decoded).toString('base64') : btoa(decoded)
    } catch {
      data = typeof Buffer !== 'undefined' ? Buffer.from(raw).toString('base64') : btoa(raw)
    }
  }
  return { mimeType, data }
}

export function isLocalFilePath(str: string): boolean {
  if (typeof str !== 'string' || str === '') return false
  return isAbsolutePath(str) || str.startsWith('./') || str.startsWith('.\\') || str.startsWith('../') || str.startsWith('..\\')
}

export function normalizeFileUrlToPath(uri: string): string {
  if (!uri.startsWith('file://')) return uri
  let raw = uri.slice('file://'.length)
  try {
    raw = decodeURIComponent(raw)
  } catch {}
  if (raw.startsWith('localhost/')) {
    raw = raw.slice('localhost'.length)
  }
  if (/^\/?[a-zA-Z]:/.test(raw)) {
    return raw.startsWith('/') ? raw.slice(1) : raw
  }
  if (raw.startsWith('/')) {
    return raw
  }
  return `//${raw}`
}

function expandHomePath(p: string): string {
  if (p === '~' || p.startsWith('~/') || p.startsWith('~\\')) {
    if (typeof process !== 'undefined' && process.env) {
      const env = process.env
      const home = env.HOME || env.USERPROFILE || (env.HOMEDRIVE && env.HOMEPATH ? `${env.HOMEDRIVE}${env.HOMEPATH}` : undefined)
      if (home) {
        const cleanHome = home.replaceAll('\\', '/').replace(/\/+$/, '')
        return p === '~' ? cleanHome : `${cleanHome}/${p.slice(2).replaceAll('\\', '/')}`
      }
    }
  }
  return p
}

function readImageFileFromContext(filePath: string, context?: unknown): Buffer | Uint8Array | string | undefined {
  const target = normalizeFileUrlToPath(filePath)
  const expanded = expandHomePath(target)
  const pathsToTry = target === expanded ? [target] : [target, expanded]

  const builtinFs = typeof process !== 'undefined' && typeof (process as unknown as { getBuiltinModule?: (m: string) => unknown }).getBuiltinModule === 'function'
    ? ((process as unknown as { getBuiltinModule: (m: string) => unknown }).getBuiltinModule('fs') as { existsSync?: (p: string) => boolean; readFileSync?: (p: string) => Buffer } | null)
    : null

  for (const p of pathsToTry) {
    if (context && typeof (context as { readFile?: unknown }).readFile === 'function') {
      try {
        const res = (context as { readFile: (path: string) => unknown }).readFile(p)
        if (res !== undefined) return res as Buffer | Uint8Array | string
      } catch {}
    }
    if (context && typeof (context as { fs?: { readFileSync?: unknown } }).fs?.readFileSync === 'function') {
      try {
        const res = (context as { fs: { readFileSync: (path: string) => unknown } }).fs.readFileSync(p)
        if (res !== undefined) return res as Buffer | Uint8Array | string
      } catch {}
    }
    if (builtinFs && typeof builtinFs.existsSync === 'function' && typeof builtinFs.readFileSync === 'function') {
      try {
        if (builtinFs.existsSync(p)) return builtinFs.readFileSync(p)
      } catch {}
    }
  }
  return undefined
}

/**
 * Detect image MIME type by examining binary magic numbers.
 * Supports Buffer, Uint8Array, and base64 strings.
 */
export function detectImageMimeFromMagic(raw: Buffer | Uint8Array | string | undefined): string | undefined {
  if (!raw) return undefined
  let bytes: Uint8Array | undefined
  if (typeof raw === 'string') {
    const trimmed = raw.trim()
    if (trimmed.startsWith('<svg') || (trimmed.startsWith('<?xml') && trimmed.includes('<svg'))) {
      return 'image/svg+xml'
    }
    try {
      const prefix = trimmed.slice(0, 64).replace(/\s+/g, '')
      if (typeof Buffer !== 'undefined') {
        bytes = Buffer.from(prefix, 'base64')
      } else if (typeof atob !== 'undefined') {
        const bin = atob(prefix)
        bytes = new Uint8Array(bin.length)
        for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) bytes[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i)
      }
    } catch {
      return undefined
    }
  } else if (raw instanceof Uint8Array || (typeof Buffer !== 'undefined' && Buffer.isBuffer(raw))) {
    bytes = raw instanceof Uint8Array ? raw : new Uint8Array(raw)
  }

  if (!bytes || bytes.length < 3) return undefined

  // PNG: 89 50 4E 47 0D 0A 1A 0A
  if (bytes.length >= 8 &&
      bytes[0] === 0x89 && bytes[1] === 0x50 && bytes[2] === 0x4e && bytes[3] === 0x47 &&
      bytes[4] === 0x0d && bytes[5] === 0x0a && bytes[6] === 0x1a && bytes[7] === 0x0a) {
    return 'image/png'
  }

  // JPEG: FF D8 FF
  if (bytes[0] === 0xff && bytes[1] === 0xd8 && bytes[2] === 0xff) {
    return 'image/jpeg'
  }

  // GIF: GIF87a or GIF89a (47 49 46 38)
  if (bytes.length >= 6 &&
      bytes[0] === 0x47 && bytes[1] === 0x49 && bytes[2] === 0x46 && bytes[3] === 0x38 &&
      (bytes[4] === 0x37 || bytes[4] === 0x39) && bytes[5] === 0x61) {
    return 'image/gif'
  }

  // WebP: RIFF....WEBP (52 49 46 46 .... 57 45 42 50)
  if (bytes.length >= 12 &&
      bytes[0] === 0x52 && bytes[1] === 0x49 && bytes[2] === 0x46 && bytes[3] === 0x46 &&
      bytes[8] === 0x57 && bytes[9] === 0x45 && bytes[10] === 0x42 && bytes[11] === 0x50) {
    return 'image/webp'
  }

  // BMP: 42 4D ("BM")
  if (bytes.length >= 2 && bytes[0] === 0x42 && bytes[1] === 0x4d) {
    return 'image/bmp'
  }

  // ICO: 00 00 01 00
  if (bytes.length >= 4 && bytes[0] === 0x00 && bytes[1] === 0x00 && bytes[2] === 0x01 && bytes[3] === 0x00) {
    return 'image/x-icon'
  }

  // TIFF: II*. (49 49 2A 00) or MM.* (4D 4D 00 2A)
  if (bytes.length >= 4 &&
      ((bytes[0] === 0x49 && bytes[1] === 0x49 && bytes[2] === 0x2a && bytes[3] === 0x00) ||
       (bytes[0] === 0x4d && bytes[1] === 0x4d && bytes[2] === 0x00 && bytes[3] === 0x2a))) {
    return 'image/tiff'
  }

  // AVIF / HEIC: ftyp box at offset 4 (bytes 4..7 === 'ftyp')
  if (bytes.length >= 12 &&
      bytes[4] === 0x66 && bytes[5] === 0x74 && bytes[6] === 0x79 && bytes[7] === 0x70) {
    const brand = String.fromCharCode(bytes[8], bytes[9], bytes[10], bytes[11]).toLowerCase()
    if (brand === 'avif' || brand === 'avis') return 'image/avif'
    if (brand === 'heic' || brand === 'heix' || brand === 'hevc' || brand === 'mif1' || brand === 'msf1') return 'image/heic'
  }

  return undefined
}

function tryResolveFromAttachmentStore(
  store: Record<string, unknown>,
  id: string,
  context?: unknown,
  attachmentMeta?: unknown,
): unknown {
  const idWithoutPrefix = id.startsWith('sha256:') ? id.slice('sha256:'.length) : undefined
  const idWithPrefix = id.startsWith('sha256:') ? id : `sha256:${id}`

  const candidates: unknown[] = []
  if (attachmentMeta && typeof attachmentMeta === 'object') {
    candidates.push(attachmentMeta)
  }
  candidates.push({ attachmentId: idWithPrefix })
  if (idWithoutPrefix !== undefined) {
    candidates.push({ attachmentId: idWithoutPrefix })
  }
  candidates.push({ attachmentId: id })
  candidates.push({ id: idWithPrefix })
  candidates.push({ id })
  if (idWithoutPrefix !== undefined) {
    candidates.push({ id: idWithoutPrefix })
  }
  candidates.push(id)
  if (idWithoutPrefix !== undefined) {
    candidates.push(idWithoutPrefix)
  }

  // Cordis proxies wrap the underlying service instance; if a method call on the proxy fails
  // or loses this context, fall back to the unwrapped instance (never the class prototype,
  // which lacks instance state such as `this.root`).
  const cordisOriginal = Reflect.get(store, Symbol.for('cordis.original')) as Record<string, unknown> | undefined

  // A. LocalAttachmentStore.imageHostPath(ref) -> synchronous local absolute path
  if (typeof store.imageHostPath === 'function') {
    const fn = store.imageHostPath as (ref: unknown) => unknown
    for (const cand of candidates) {
      if (cand === undefined) continue
      try {
        let hostPath: unknown
        try {
          hostPath = fn.call(store, cand)
        } catch {
          if (cordisOriginal && typeof cordisOriginal.imageHostPath === 'function') {
            hostPath = (cordisOriginal.imageHostPath as (ref: unknown) => unknown).call(cordisOriginal, cand)
          }
        }
        if (hostPath && typeof (hostPath as Promise<unknown>).then === 'function') {
          if (typeof (hostPath as Promise<unknown>).catch === 'function') {
            (hostPath as Promise<unknown>).catch(() => {})
          }
        } else if (typeof hostPath === 'string' && hostPath.trim() !== '') {
          const fileContent = readImageFileFromContext(hostPath, context)
          return {
            path: hostPath,
            ...(fileContent !== undefined ? { data: fileContent } : {}),
          }
        }
      } catch {}
    }
  }

  // B. LocalAttachmentStore.fileHostPath(ref) -> fallback for file-type attachments
  if (typeof store.fileHostPath === 'function') {
    const fn = store.fileHostPath as (ref: unknown) => unknown
    for (const cand of candidates) {
      if (cand === undefined) continue
      try {
        let hostPath: unknown
        try {
          hostPath = fn.call(store, cand)
        } catch {
          if (cordisOriginal && typeof cordisOriginal.fileHostPath === 'function') {
            hostPath = (cordisOriginal.fileHostPath as (ref: unknown) => unknown).call(cordisOriginal, cand)
          }
        }
        if (hostPath && typeof (hostPath as Promise<unknown>).then === 'function') {
          if (typeof (hostPath as Promise<unknown>).catch === 'function') {
            (hostPath as Promise<unknown>).catch(() => {})
          }
        } else if (typeof hostPath === 'string' && hostPath.trim() !== '') {
          const fileContent = readImageFileFromContext(hostPath, context)
          return {
            path: hostPath,
            ...(fileContent !== undefined ? { data: fileContent } : {}),
          }
        }
      } catch {}
    }
  }

  // C. LocalAttachmentStore.readImage(ref) -> { ref, data: Uint8Array }
  if (typeof store.readImage === 'function') {
    const fn = store.readImage as (ref: unknown) => unknown
    for (const cand of candidates) {
      if (cand === undefined) continue
      try {
        let res: unknown
        try {
          res = fn.call(store, cand)
        } catch {
          if (cordisOriginal && typeof cordisOriginal.readImage === 'function') {
            res = (cordisOriginal.readImage as (ref: unknown) => unknown).call(cordisOriginal, cand)
          }
        }
        if (res && typeof res === 'object') {
          // If it's a Promise (async), safely attach catch to avoid unhandledRejection crashes
          if (typeof (res as Promise<unknown>).then === 'function') {
            if (typeof (res as Promise<unknown>).catch === 'function') {
              (res as Promise<unknown>).catch(() => {})
            }
          } else {
            if (res instanceof Uint8Array || (typeof Buffer !== 'undefined' && Buffer.isBuffer(res))) {
              return res
            }
            const data = (res as { data?: unknown }).data
            if (data instanceof Uint8Array || (typeof Buffer !== 'undefined' && Buffer.isBuffer(data)) || typeof data === 'string') {
              return { data }
            }
          }
        }
      } catch {}
    }
  }

  // D. readAttachment
  if (typeof store.readAttachment === 'function') {
    try {
      let res: unknown
      try {
        res = (store.readAttachment as (id: string) => unknown).call(store, id)
      } catch {
        if (cordisOriginal && typeof cordisOriginal.readAttachment === 'function') {
          res = (cordisOriginal.readAttachment as (id: string) => unknown).call(cordisOriginal, id)
        }
      }
      if (res && typeof (res as Promise<unknown>).then === 'function') {
        if (typeof (res as Promise<unknown>).catch === 'function') {
          (res as Promise<unknown>).catch(() => {})
        }
      } else if (res !== undefined) {
        return res
      }
    } catch {}
  }

  // E. getAttachment
  if (typeof store.getAttachment === 'function') {
    try {
      let res: unknown
      try {
        res = (store.getAttachment as (id: string) => unknown).call(store, id)
      } catch {
        if (cordisOriginal && typeof cordisOriginal.getAttachment === 'function') {
          res = (cordisOriginal.getAttachment as (id: string) => unknown).call(cordisOriginal, id)
        }
      }
      if (res && typeof (res as Promise<unknown>).then === 'function') {
        if (typeof (res as Promise<unknown>).catch === 'function') {
          (res as Promise<unknown>).catch(() => {})
        }
      } else if (res !== undefined) {
        return res
      }
    } catch {}
  }

  return undefined
}

function tryStoreFreeDiskAttachment(id: string, context?: unknown): unknown {
  if (typeof id !== 'string') return undefined
  let hash: string | undefined
  const trimmed = id.trim()
  if (trimmed.startsWith('sha256:')) {
    hash = trimmed.slice('sha256:'.length).toLowerCase()
  } else if (/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/i.test(trimmed)) {
    hash = trimmed.toLowerCase()
  }
  if (!hash || hash.length < 2) return undefined

  const prefix = hash.slice(0, 2)
  const relPaths = [
    `attachments/v1/objects/${prefix}/${hash}`,
    `attachments/v1/file-objects/${prefix}/${hash}`,
  ]

  const candidatePaths: string[] = []

  if (typeof process !== 'undefined' && process.env) {
    const env = process.env
    if (env.DSH_NTR_STATE_DIR) {
      const stateDir = env.DSH_NTR_STATE_DIR.replaceAll('\\', '/').replace(/\/+$/, '')
      const hostDir = stateDir.endsWith('/dsh-ntr') ? stateDir.slice(0, -'/dsh-ntr'.length) : stateDir
      for (const rel of relPaths) candidatePaths.push(`${hostDir}/${rel}`)
    }
    if (env.DSH_DIR) {
      const dshDir = env.DSH_DIR.replaceAll('\\', '/').replace(/\/+$/, '')
      for (const rel of relPaths) candidatePaths.push(`${dshDir}/${rel}`)
    }
    const home = env.HOME || env.USERPROFILE || (env.HOMEDRIVE && env.HOMEPATH ? `${env.HOMEDRIVE}${env.HOMEPATH}` : undefined)
    if (home) {
      const cleanHome = home.replaceAll('\\', '/').replace(/\/+$/, '')
      for (const rel of relPaths) {
        candidatePaths.push(`${cleanHome}/.dsh/${rel}`)
        candidatePaths.push(`${cleanHome}\\.dsh\\${rel.replaceAll('/', '\\')}`)
      }
    }
  }
  for (const rel of relPaths) candidatePaths.push(`~/.dsh/${rel}`)

  for (const p of candidatePaths) {
    const fileContent = readImageFileFromContext(p, context)
    if (fileContent !== undefined) {
      return {
        path: p,
        data: fileContent,
      }
    }
  }

  return undefined
}

export function resolveImageAttachmentFromContext(
  id: string,
  context?: unknown,
  attachmentMeta?: unknown,
  rootContext?: unknown,
): unknown {
  const root = rootContext ?? context
  if (context && typeof context === 'object') {
    const ctx = context as Record<string, unknown>

    const direct = tryResolveFromAttachmentStore(ctx, id, root, attachmentMeta)
    if (direct !== undefined) return direct

    if (typeof ctx.get === 'function') {
      try {
        const svc = (ctx.get as (name: string) => unknown)('attachments') ?? (ctx.get as (name: string) => unknown)('attachmentService')
        if (svc && typeof svc === 'object') {
          const res = resolveImageAttachmentFromContext(id, svc, attachmentMeta, root)
          if (res !== undefined) return res
        }
      } catch {}
    }

    try {
      if (ctx.attachmentService && typeof ctx.attachmentService === 'object') {
        const res = resolveImageAttachmentFromContext(id, ctx.attachmentService, attachmentMeta, root)
        if (res !== undefined) return res
      }
    } catch {}

    try {
      const attStore = ctx.attachments
      if (attStore) {
        if (typeof attStore === 'object') {
          const fromStore = tryResolveFromAttachmentStore(attStore as Record<string, unknown>, id, root, attachmentMeta)
          if (fromStore !== undefined) return fromStore
        }
        if (attStore instanceof Map || typeof (attStore as { get?: unknown }).get === 'function') {
          try { return (attStore as Map<string, unknown>).get(id) } catch {}
        }
        if (typeof attStore === 'object' && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(attStore, id)) {
          return (attStore as Record<string, unknown>)[id]
        }
      }
    } catch {}
  }

  return tryStoreFreeDiskAttachment(id, root)
}

function toBase64(data: Buffer | Uint8Array | string): string {
  if (typeof data === 'string') return data.replace(/\s+/g, '')
  if (typeof Buffer !== 'undefined') return Buffer.from(data).toString('base64')
  let binary = ''
  const bytes = data instanceof Uint8Array ? data : new Uint8Array(data)
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.byteLength; i++) {
    binary += String.fromCharCode(bytes[i])
  }
  return btoa(binary)
}

/**
 * Extract an image payload (Base64 data + MIME type) from an image block and optional context.
 */
export function resolveImageContent(block: unknown, context?: unknown): PromptImageContent | undefined {
  if (!block || typeof block !== 'object') return undefined
  const b = block as Record<string, unknown>
  const attRecord = b.attachment && typeof b.attachment === 'object' ? (b.attachment as Record<string, unknown>) : undefined
  const isExplicitImageBlock = b.type === 'image' || b.type === 'image_url' || b.type === 'attachment'
  const explicitMime = (typeof attRecord?.mediaType === 'string' && attRecord.mediaType.trim().toLowerCase()) ||
    (typeof attRecord?.mimeType === 'string' && attRecord.mimeType.trim().toLowerCase()) ||
    (typeof b.mediaType === 'string' && b.mediaType.trim().toLowerCase()) ||
    (typeof b.mimeType === 'string' && b.mimeType.trim().toLowerCase()) ||
    (typeof b.contentType === 'string' && b.contentType.trim().toLowerCase()) ||
    undefined

  // 1. Direct base64 data: { data: string | Buffer | Uint8Array, mimeType?: string }
  if (typeof b.data === 'string' && b.data.trim() !== '') {
    if (b.data.startsWith('data:')) {
      const parsed = parseImageDataUrl(b.data)
      if (parsed) {
        const mimeType = explicitMime || parsed.mimeType || detectImageMimeFromMagic(parsed.data) || 'image/png'
        return { type: 'image', data: parsed.data, mimeType, ...(typeof b.uri === 'string' ? { uri: b.uri } : {}) }
      }
      return undefined
    }
    const mimeType = explicitMime || detectImageMimeFromMagic(b.data) || (isExplicitImageBlock ? 'image/png' : undefined)
    if (mimeType && mimeType.startsWith('image/')) {
      return {
        type: 'image',
        data: b.data.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ''),
        mimeType,
        ...(typeof b.uri === 'string' ? { uri: b.uri } : {}),
      }
    }
  }
  if (typeof Buffer !== 'undefined' && Buffer.isBuffer(b.data)) {
    const mimeType = explicitMime || detectImageMimeFromMagic(b.data) || (isExplicitImageBlock ? 'image/png' : undefined)
    if (mimeType && mimeType.startsWith('image/')) {
      return { type: 'image', data: b.data.toString('base64'), mimeType, ...(typeof b.uri === 'string' ? { uri: b.uri } : {}) }
    }
  }
  if (b.data instanceof Uint8Array) {
    const mimeType = explicitMime || detectImageMimeFromMagic(b.data) || (isExplicitImageBlock ? 'image/png' : undefined)
    if (mimeType && mimeType.startsWith('image/')) {
      return { type: 'image', data: toBase64(b.data), mimeType, ...(typeof b.uri === 'string' ? { uri: b.uri } : {}) }
    }
  }

  // 2. Anthropic style: source: { type: 'base64', media_type: string, data: string }
  if (b.source && typeof b.source === 'object') {
    const src = b.source as Record<string, unknown>
    const srcMime = (typeof src.media_type === 'string' && src.media_type.trim().toLowerCase()) ||
      (typeof src.mimeType === 'string' && src.mimeType.trim().toLowerCase()) ||
      explicitMime ||
      (typeof src.data === 'string' || src.data instanceof Uint8Array || (typeof Buffer !== 'undefined' && Buffer.isBuffer(src.data)) ? detectImageMimeFromMagic(src.data as Buffer | Uint8Array | string) : undefined) ||
      'image/png'
    if (srcMime.startsWith('image/')) {
      if (typeof src.data === 'string' && src.data.trim() !== '') {
        return {
          type: 'image',
          data: src.data.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ''),
          mimeType: srcMime,
          ...(typeof b.uri === 'string' ? { uri: b.uri } : {}),
        }
      }
      if (typeof Buffer !== 'undefined' && Buffer.isBuffer(src.data)) {
        return { type: 'image', data: src.data.toString('base64'), mimeType: srcMime, ...(typeof b.uri === 'string' ? { uri: b.uri } : {}) }
      }
      if (src.data instanceof Uint8Array) {
        return { type: 'image', data: toBase64(src.data), mimeType: srcMime, ...(typeof b.uri === 'string' ? { uri: b.uri } : {}) }
      }
    }
  }

  // 3. Image property: { image: string | Buffer | Uint8Array }
  if (typeof b.image === 'string' && b.image.trim() !== '') {
    if (b.image.startsWith('data:')) {
      const parsed = parseImageDataUrl(b.image)
      if (parsed) return { type: 'image', data: parsed.data, mimeType: explicitMime || parsed.mimeType || detectImageMimeFromMagic(parsed.data) || 'image/png' }
      return undefined
    }
    const mimeType = explicitMime || detectImageMimeFromMagic(b.image) || (isExplicitImageBlock ? 'image/png' : undefined)
    if (mimeType && mimeType.startsWith('image/')) {
      return { type: 'image', data: b.image.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ''), mimeType }
    }
  }
  if (typeof Buffer !== 'undefined' && Buffer.isBuffer(b.image)) {
    const mimeType = explicitMime || detectImageMimeFromMagic(b.image) || (isExplicitImageBlock ? 'image/png' : undefined)
    if (mimeType && mimeType.startsWith('image/')) return { type: 'image', data: b.image.toString('base64'), mimeType }
  }
  if (b.image instanceof Uint8Array) {
    const mimeType = explicitMime || detectImageMimeFromMagic(b.image) || (isExplicitImageBlock ? 'image/png' : undefined)
    if (mimeType && mimeType.startsWith('image/')) return { type: 'image', data: toBase64(b.image), mimeType }
  }

  // 4. OpenAI style image_url: { image_url: string | { url: string } }
  if (b.image_url) {
    const urlStr = typeof b.image_url === 'string'
      ? b.image_url
      : (typeof b.image_url === 'object' && b.image_url !== null ? (b.image_url as Record<string, unknown>).url : undefined)
    if (typeof urlStr === 'string' && urlStr.trim() !== '') {
      if (urlStr.startsWith('data:')) {
        const parsed = parseImageDataUrl(urlStr)
        if (parsed) return { type: 'image', data: parsed.data, mimeType: explicitMime || parsed.mimeType || detectImageMimeFromMagic(parsed.data) || 'image/png', uri: urlStr }
        return undefined
      }
      if (urlStr.startsWith('http://') || urlStr.startsWith('https://')) {
        const mimeType = explicitMime || guessImageMimeType(urlStr) || 'image/png'
        return { type: 'image', data: '', mimeType, uri: urlStr }
      }
      if (urlStr.startsWith('file://') || isLocalFilePath(urlStr)) {
        const fileContent = readImageFileFromContext(urlStr, context)
        if (fileContent !== undefined) {
          let data: string
          let resolvedMime: string | undefined
          if (typeof fileContent === 'string') {
            if (fileContent.startsWith('data:')) {
              const parsed = parseImageDataUrl(fileContent)
              if (parsed) {
                data = parsed.data
                resolvedMime = parsed.mimeType
              } else {
                return undefined
              }
            } else {
              data = fileContent.trim().replace(/\s+/g, '')
            }
          } else {
            data = toBase64(fileContent)
          }
          const mimeType = explicitMime || resolvedMime || guessImageMimeType(urlStr) || detectImageMimeFromMagic(fileContent) || (isExplicitImageBlock ? 'image/png' : undefined)
          if (mimeType && mimeType.startsWith('image/')) {
            return { type: 'image', data, mimeType, uri: urlStr }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // 5. Direct buffer / content on block: { buffer: Buffer } or { content: Buffer }
  if (b.buffer && (typeof Buffer !== 'undefined' && Buffer.isBuffer(b.buffer) || b.buffer instanceof Uint8Array)) {
    const data = typeof Buffer !== 'undefined' && Buffer.isBuffer(b.buffer) ? b.buffer.toString('base64') : toBase64(b.buffer as Uint8Array)
    const mimeType = explicitMime || detectImageMimeFromMagic(b.buffer as Buffer | Uint8Array) || (isExplicitImageBlock ? 'image/png' : undefined)
    if (mimeType && mimeType.startsWith('image/')) {
      return { type: 'image', data, mimeType, ...(typeof b.uri === 'string' ? { uri: b.uri } : {}) }
    }
  }
  if (b.content && (typeof Buffer !== 'undefined' && Buffer.isBuffer(b.content) || b.content instanceof Uint8Array)) {
    const data = typeof Buffer !== 'undefined' && Buffer.isBuffer(b.content) ? b.content.toString('base64') : toBase64(b.content as Uint8Array)
    const mimeType = explicitMime || detectImageMimeFromMagic(b.content as Buffer | Uint8Array) || (isExplicitImageBlock ? 'image/png' : undefined)
    if (mimeType && mimeType.startsWith('image/')) {
      return { type: 'image', data, mimeType, ...(typeof b.uri === 'string' ? { uri: b.uri } : {}) }
    }
  }

  // 6. Data URL or Remote URL in `url`
  if (typeof b.url === 'string') {
    if (b.url.startsWith('data:')) {
      const parsed = parseImageDataUrl(b.url)
      if (parsed) return { type: 'image', data: parsed.data, mimeType: explicitMime || parsed.mimeType || detectImageMimeFromMagic(parsed.data) || 'image/png', uri: b.url }
      return undefined
    }
    if (b.url.startsWith('http://') || b.url.startsWith('https://')) {
      const mimeType = explicitMime || guessImageMimeType(b.url) || 'image/png'
      return { type: 'image', data: '', mimeType, uri: b.url }
    }
  }

  // 7. File path in `path`, `filePath`, or `url: file://...`
  let filePath: string | undefined
  if (typeof b.path === 'string' && b.path !== '') filePath = b.path
  else if (typeof b.filePath === 'string' && b.filePath !== '') filePath = b.filePath
  else if (typeof b.url === 'string' && (b.url.startsWith('file://') || isLocalFilePath(b.url))) filePath = b.url

  if (filePath !== undefined) {
    const fileContent = readImageFileFromContext(filePath, context)
    if (fileContent !== undefined) {
      let data: string
      let resolvedMime: string | undefined
      if (typeof fileContent === 'string') {
        if (fileContent.startsWith('data:')) {
          const parsed = parseImageDataUrl(fileContent)
          if (parsed) {
            data = parsed.data
            resolvedMime = parsed.mimeType
          } else {
            return undefined
          }
        } else {
          data = fileContent.trim().replace(/\s+/g, '')
        }
      } else {
        data = toBase64(fileContent)
      }
      const mimeType = explicitMime ||
        resolvedMime ||
        guessImageMimeType(filePath) ||
        detectImageMimeFromMagic(fileContent) ||
        (isExplicitImageBlock ? 'image/png' : undefined)

      if (mimeType && mimeType.startsWith('image/')) {
        let uri = typeof b.url === 'string' ? b.url : undefined
        if (!uri) {
          if (filePath.startsWith('file://')) {
            uri = filePath
          } else if (isAbsolutePath(filePath)) {
            if (filePath.startsWith('//') || filePath.startsWith('\\\\')) {
              uri = `file://${filePath.replace(/^[\/\\]+/, '').replace(/\\/g, '/')}`
            } else if (/^[a-zA-Z]:/.test(filePath)) {
              uri = `file:///${filePath.replace(/\\/g, '/')}`
            } else {
              uri = `file://${filePath.startsWith('/') ? filePath : `/${filePath}`}`
            }
          } else {
            uri = filePath
          }
        }
        return {
          type: 'image',
          data,
          mimeType,
          uri,
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // 8. Attachment resolution via context
  let attachmentId: string | undefined
  if (attRecord && typeof attRecord.attachmentId === 'string' && attRecord.attachmentId.trim() !== '') {
    attachmentId = attRecord.attachmentId.trim()
  } else if (typeof b.attachmentId === 'string' && b.attachmentId.trim() !== '') {
    attachmentId = b.attachmentId.trim()
  } else if (attRecord && typeof attRecord.id === 'string' && attRecord.id.trim() !== '') {
    attachmentId = attRecord.id.trim()
  } else if (typeof b.id === 'string' && b.id.trim() !== '') {
    attachmentId = b.id.trim()
  } else if (typeof b.attachment === 'string' && b.attachment.trim() !== '') {
    attachmentId = b.attachment.trim()
  } else if (typeof b.url === 'string' && b.url.startsWith('attachment:')) {
    attachmentId = b.url.replace(/^attachment:\/\/|^attachment:/, '')
  } else if (typeof b.image_url === 'string' && b.image_url.startsWith('attachment:')) {
    attachmentId = b.image_url.replace(/^attachment:\/\/|^attachment:/, '')
  } else if (b.image_url && typeof b.image_url === 'object' && typeof (b.image_url as Record<string, unknown>).url === 'string' && ((b.image_url as Record<string, unknown>).url as string).startsWith('attachment:')) {
    attachmentId = ((b.image_url as Record<string, unknown>).url as string).replace(/^attachment:\/\/|^attachment:/, '')
  }

  if (attachmentId !== undefined) {
    const rawAtt = resolveImageAttachmentFromContext(attachmentId, context, b.attachment)
    if (rawAtt !== undefined) {
      if (typeof rawAtt === 'string') {
        if (rawAtt.startsWith('data:')) {
          const parsed = parseImageDataUrl(rawAtt)
          if (parsed) {
            const mimeType = explicitMime || parsed.mimeType || detectImageMimeFromMagic(parsed.data) || 'image/png'
            return {
              type: 'image',
              data: parsed.data,
              mimeType,
              uri: typeof b.uri === 'string' ? b.uri : `attachment://${attachmentId}`,
            }
          }
          return undefined
        } else if (rawAtt.startsWith('file://') || isLocalFilePath(rawAtt)) {
          const fileContent = readImageFileFromContext(rawAtt, context)
          if (fileContent !== undefined) {
            let data: string
            let resolvedMime: string | undefined
            if (typeof fileContent === 'string') {
              if (fileContent.startsWith('data:')) {
                const parsed = parseImageDataUrl(fileContent)
                if (parsed) {
                  data = parsed.data
                  resolvedMime = parsed.mimeType
                } else {
                  return undefined
                }
              } else {
                data = fileContent.trim().replace(/\s+/g, '')
              }
            } else {
              data = toBase64(fileContent)
            }
            const mimeType = explicitMime ||
              resolvedMime ||
              (typeof attRecord?.name === 'string' ? guessImageMimeType(attRecord.name) : undefined) ||
              guessImageMimeType(rawAtt) ||
              detectImageMimeFromMagic(fileContent) ||
              (isExplicitImageBlock ? 'image/png' : undefined)
            if (mimeType && mimeType.startsWith('image/')) {
              return { type: 'image', data, mimeType, uri: typeof b.uri === 'string' ? b.uri : `attachment://${attachmentId}` }
            }
          }
        }
        const mimeType = explicitMime ||
          (typeof attRecord?.name === 'string' ? guessImageMimeType(attRecord.name) : undefined) ||
          guessImageMimeType(attachmentId) ||
          detectImageMimeFromMagic(rawAtt) ||
          (isExplicitImageBlock ? 'image/png' : undefined)
        if (mimeType && mimeType.startsWith('image/')) {
          return { type: 'image', data: rawAtt.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ''), mimeType, uri: typeof b.uri === 'string' ? b.uri : `attachment://${attachmentId}` }
        }
      }
      if (typeof rawAtt === 'object' && rawAtt !== null) {
        if (typeof Buffer !== 'undefined' && Buffer.isBuffer(rawAtt)) {
          const mimeType = explicitMime ||
            (typeof attRecord?.name === 'string' ? guessImageMimeType(attRecord.name) : undefined) ||
            guessImageMimeType(attachmentId) ||
            detectImageMimeFromMagic(rawAtt) ||
            (isExplicitImageBlock ? 'image/png' : undefined)
          if (mimeType && mimeType.startsWith('image/')) {
            return {
              type: 'image',
              data: rawAtt.toString('base64'),
              mimeType,
              uri: typeof b.uri === 'string' ? b.uri : `attachment://${attachmentId}`,
            }
          }
        }
        if (rawAtt instanceof Uint8Array) {
          const mimeType = explicitMime ||
            (typeof attRecord?.name === 'string' ? guessImageMimeType(attRecord.name) : undefined) ||
            guessImageMimeType(attachmentId) ||
            detectImageMimeFromMagic(rawAtt) ||
            (isExplicitImageBlock ? 'image/png' : undefined)
          if (mimeType && mimeType.startsWith('image/')) {
            return {
              type: 'image',
              data: toBase64(rawAtt),
              mimeType,
              uri: typeof b.uri === 'string' ? b.uri : `attachment://${attachmentId}`,
            }
          }
        }
        const attObj = rawAtt as Record<string, unknown>
        let data: string | undefined
        let resolvedMime: string | undefined

        const attPath = typeof attObj.path === 'string' && attObj.path !== ''
          ? attObj.path
          : (typeof attObj.filePath === 'string' && attObj.filePath !== ''
              ? attObj.filePath
              : (typeof attObj.url === 'string' && (attObj.url.startsWith('file://') || isLocalFilePath(attObj.url)) ? attObj.url : undefined))

        let fileContentForMagic: Buffer | Uint8Array | string | undefined

        if (attPath !== undefined) {
          const fileContent = readImageFileFromContext(attPath, context)
          if (fileContent !== undefined) {
            fileContentForMagic = fileContent
            if (typeof fileContent === 'string') {
              if (fileContent.startsWith('data:')) {
                const parsed = parseImageDataUrl(fileContent)
                if (parsed) {
                  data = parsed.data
                  resolvedMime = parsed.mimeType
                }
              } else {
                data = fileContent.trim().replace(/\s+/g, '')
              }
            } else {
              data = toBase64(fileContent)
            }
            if (!resolvedMime) resolvedMime = guessImageMimeType(attPath)
          }
        }

        if (data === undefined) {
          if (typeof attObj.data === 'string' && attObj.data.trim() !== '') {
            if (attObj.data.startsWith('data:')) {
              const parsed = parseImageDataUrl(attObj.data)
              if (parsed) {
                data = parsed.data
                resolvedMime = parsed.mimeType
              }
            } else {
              data = attObj.data.trim().replace(/\s+/g, '')
              fileContentForMagic = attObj.data
            }
          }
          else if (typeof Buffer !== 'undefined' && Buffer.isBuffer(attObj.data)) {
            data = attObj.data.toString('base64')
            fileContentForMagic = attObj.data
          }
          else if (attObj.data instanceof Uint8Array) {
            data = toBase64(attObj.data)
            fileContentForMagic = attObj.data
          }
          else if (typeof Buffer !== 'undefined' && Buffer.isBuffer(attObj.buffer)) {
            data = attObj.buffer.toString('base64')
            fileContentForMagic = attObj.buffer
          }
          else if (attObj.buffer instanceof Uint8Array) {
            data = toBase64(attObj.buffer)
            fileContentForMagic = attObj.buffer
          }
          else if (typeof Buffer !== 'undefined' && Buffer.isBuffer(attObj.content)) {
            data = attObj.content.toString('base64')
            fileContentForMagic = attObj.content
          }
          else if (attObj.content instanceof Uint8Array) {
            data = toBase64(attObj.content)
            fileContentForMagic = attObj.content
          }
          else if (typeof attObj.content === 'string') {
            if (attObj.content.startsWith('data:')) {
              const parsed = parseImageDataUrl(attObj.content)
              if (parsed) {
                data = parsed.data
                resolvedMime = parsed.mimeType
              }
            } else {
              data = attObj.content.trim().replace(/\s+/g, '')
              fileContentForMagic = attObj.content
            }
          }
        }

        if (data !== undefined) {
          const mimeType = explicitMime ||
            (typeof attObj.mediaType === 'string' && attObj.mediaType.toLowerCase()) ||
            (typeof attObj.mimeType === 'string' && attObj.mimeType.toLowerCase()) ||
            resolvedMime ||
            (typeof attRecord?.name === 'string' ? guessImageMimeType(attRecord.name) : undefined) ||
            (typeof attObj.name === 'string' ? guessImageMimeType(attObj.name as string) : undefined) ||
            guessImageMimeType(attachmentId) ||
            detectImageMimeFromMagic(fileContentForMagic ?? data) ||
            (isExplicitImageBlock ? 'image/png' : undefined)
          if (mimeType && mimeType.startsWith('image/')) {
            return {
              type: 'image',
              data,
              mimeType,
              uri: typeof b.uri === 'string' ? b.uri : `attachment://${attachmentId}`,
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // 9. Direct b.attachment object
  if (b.attachment && typeof b.attachment === 'object') {
    const attObj = b.attachment as Record<string, unknown>
    let data: string | undefined
    let resolvedMime: string | undefined

    const attPath = typeof attObj.path === 'string' && attObj.path !== ''
      ? attObj.path
      : (typeof attObj.filePath === 'string' && attObj.filePath !== ''
          ? attObj.filePath
          : (typeof attObj.url === 'string' && (attObj.url.startsWith('file://') || isLocalFilePath(attObj.url)) ? attObj.url : undefined))

    let fileContentForMagic: Buffer | Uint8Array | string | undefined

    if (attPath !== undefined) {
      const fileContent = readImageFileFromContext(attPath, context)
      if (fileContent !== undefined) {
        fileContentForMagic = fileContent
        if (typeof fileContent === 'string') {
          if (fileContent.startsWith('data:')) {
            const parsed = parseImageDataUrl(fileContent)
            if (parsed) {
              data = parsed.data
              resolvedMime = parsed.mimeType
            }
          } else {
            data = fileContent.trim().replace(/\s+/g, '')
          }
        } else {
          data = toBase64(fileContent)
        }
        if (!resolvedMime) resolvedMime = guessImageMimeType(attPath)
      }
    }

    if (data === undefined) {
      if (typeof attObj.data === 'string' && attObj.data.trim() !== '') {
        if (attObj.data.startsWith('data:')) {
          const parsed = parseImageDataUrl(attObj.data)
          if (parsed) {
            data = parsed.data
            resolvedMime = parsed.mimeType
          }
        } else {
          data = attObj.data.trim().replace(/\s+/g, '')
          fileContentForMagic = attObj.data
        }
      }
      else if (typeof Buffer !== 'undefined' && Buffer.isBuffer(attObj.data)) {
        data = attObj.data.toString('base64')
        fileContentForMagic = attObj.data
      }
      else if (attObj.data instanceof Uint8Array) {
        data = toBase64(attObj.data)
        fileContentForMagic = attObj.data
      }
      else if (typeof Buffer !== 'undefined' && Buffer.isBuffer(attObj.buffer)) {
        data = attObj.buffer.toString('base64')
        fileContentForMagic = attObj.buffer
      }
      else if (attObj.buffer instanceof Uint8Array) {
        data = toBase64(attObj.buffer)
        fileContentForMagic = attObj.buffer
      }
      else if (typeof Buffer !== 'undefined' && Buffer.isBuffer(attObj.content)) {
        data = attObj.content.toString('base64')
        fileContentForMagic = attObj.content
      }
      else if (attObj.content instanceof Uint8Array) {
        data = toBase64(attObj.content)
        fileContentForMagic = attObj.content
      }
      else if (typeof attObj.content === 'string') {
        if (attObj.content.startsWith('data:')) {
          const parsed = parseImageDataUrl(attObj.content)
          if (parsed) {
            data = parsed.data
            resolvedMime = parsed.mimeType
          }
        } else {
          data = attObj.content.trim().replace(/\s+/g, '')
          fileContentForMagic = attObj.content
        }
      }
    }

    if (data !== undefined) {
      const mimeType = explicitMime ||
        (typeof attObj.mediaType === 'string' && attObj.mediaType.toLowerCase()) ||
        (typeof attObj.mimeType === 'string' && attObj.mimeType.toLowerCase()) ||
        resolvedMime ||
        (typeof attObj.name === 'string' ? guessImageMimeType(attObj.name as string) : undefined) ||
        (attPath ? guessImageMimeType(attPath) : undefined) ||
        detectImageMimeFromMagic(fileContentForMagic ?? data) ||
        (isExplicitImageBlock ? 'image/png' : undefined)
      if (mimeType && mimeType.startsWith('image/')) {
        return { type: 'image', data, mimeType, ...(typeof b.uri === 'string' ? { uri: b.uri } : {}) }
      }
    }
  }

  return undefined
}
export type ForwardPromptSelection =
  | {
      kind: 'prompt'
      text: string
      id?: string
      images?: PromptImageContent[]
      content?: PromptContentBlock[]
    }
  | { kind: 'no-user-input' }
  | { kind: 'empty' }

/**
 * Select the user's own words out of a host-built request.
 *
 * Why this exists (AGENTS.md rule 16): the host appends its context sections
 * *after* the claimed user batch — `agent-instructions` folds its digest right
 * behind the prompt, and the driver appends the runtime-context snapshot after
 * that — so "the last user-role message" is routinely an injected section, not
 * the prompt. Only the message's `source` distinguishes them: `kind: 'user'` is
 * the person, anything else (`plugin`, `skill-catalog`, `agent-instructions`,
 * `tool`, …) is harness context. An absent source means a hand-built request
 * (tests, headless callers) and counts as user input.
 *
 * @param messages - the request's ordered messages, exactly as the host built them.
 * @param context - optional host context or attachment resolver for reading attachments.
 * @returns the last real user message's text and any image content blocks, or why there is none to forward.
 */
export function selectForwardPrompt(messages: readonly {
  role: string
  content?: string | Array<{ type?: string; text?: string; [k: string]: unknown }> | { type?: string; text?: string; [k: string]: unknown }
  source?: { kind?: string }
  id?: string
}[], context?: unknown): ForwardPromptSelection {
  let sawUserRole = false
  let last: {
    text: string
    id?: string
    images?: PromptImageContent[]
    content?: PromptContentBlock[]
  } | undefined
  for (const message of messages) {
    if (message.role !== 'user') continue
    sawUserRole = true
    const kind = message.source?.kind
    if (kind !== undefined && kind !== 'user') continue

    const content = message.content ?? (message as { parts?: unknown }).parts
    const rawBlocks: Array<Record<string, unknown>> = Array.isArray(content)
      ? (content as Array<Record<string, unknown>>)
      : (typeof content === 'string'
          ? [{ type: 'text', text: content }]
          : (typeof content === 'object' && content !== null ? [content as Record<string, unknown>] : []))

    const text = rawBlocks
      .filter(block => block.type === 'text' && typeof block.text === 'string')
      .map(block => block.text as string)
      .join('\n')
      .trim()

    const images: PromptImageContent[] = []
    const contentBlocks: PromptContentBlock[] = []

    for (const block of rawBlocks) {
      if (!block || typeof block !== 'object') continue
      if (block.type === 'text' && typeof block.text === 'string') {
        if (block.text.trim() !== '') {
          contentBlocks.push({ type: 'text', text: block.text })
        }
      } else {
        const resolved = resolveImageContent(block, context)
        if (resolved !== undefined) {
          images.push(resolved)
          contentBlocks.push(resolved)
        }
      }
    }

    if (text === '' && images.length === 0) continue

    const item: {
      text: string
      id?: string
      images?: PromptImageContent[]
      content?: PromptContentBlock[]
    } = { text, ...(message.id === undefined ? {} : { id: message.id }) }
    if (images.length > 0) {
      item.images = images
      item.content = contentBlocks
    }
    last = item
  }
  if (last !== undefined) return { kind: 'prompt', ...last }
  return sawUserRole ? { kind: 'no-user-input' } : { kind: 'empty' }
}

// ---- The agent's own permission vocabulary ----

/** ACP `ToolCall.kind` values that are known to take a file effect. */
const WRITE_TOOL_KINDS = new Set(['edit', 'delete', 'move'])

/** ACP `ToolCall.kind` values that provably take no file effect. */
const READ_TOOL_KINDS = new Set(['read', 'search', 'think', 'fetch', 'switch_mode'])

/** Structural read of ACP `ToolCall.kind`; anything unexpected stays `undefined` (= effect unknown). */
export function permissionToolKind(toolCall: unknown): string | undefined {
  const kind = (toolCall as { kind?: unknown } | null | undefined)?.kind
  return typeof kind === 'string' && kind !== '' ? kind : undefined
}

/** Structural read of ACP `ToolCall.locations[].path` — where an edit claims it will write. */
export function permissionToolPaths(toolCall: unknown): string[] {
  const locations = (toolCall as { locations?: unknown } | null | undefined)?.locations
  if (!Array.isArray(locations)) return []
  const out: string[] = []
  for (const entry of locations) {
    const path = (entry as { path?: unknown } | null | undefined)?.path
    if (typeof path === 'string' && path !== '') out.push(path)
  }
  return out
}

/**
 * Lexical containment test: does `path` equal or live under `root`?
 *
 * Both sides go through the compare form (win32-style paths get `\` folded to
 * `/` and case dropped; POSIX stays byte-exact), so a disk-derived canonical
 * path compares against a configured root regardless of which spelling each
 * arrived in — `C:\work` and `\\host\share` contain their `c:/work/…` and
 * `//host/share/…` children, while `/work2` still does not pass under `/work`
 * anywhere. A root of `/` contains every POSIX absolute path and nothing
 * Windows-shaped; any other non-absolute root contains nothing.
 */
export function isUnderPath(path: string, root: string): boolean {
  if (!isAbsolutePath(root)) return false
  const trimmedRoot = compareForm(root)
  const trimmedPath = compareForm(path)
  // A root that strips down to nothing IS the POSIX root: it spans one
  // filesystem tree, not every drive and share this plugin can see. `path` (not
  // the trimmed form) decides, because the trim also empties a path of `/` itself.
  if (trimmedRoot === '') return path.startsWith('/') && !isWin32Style(path)
  return trimmedPath === trimmedRoot || trimmedPath.startsWith(`${trimmedRoot}/`)
}

// ---- The agent preset a session runs ----

/**
 * The slice of a host session log the preset fold reads.
 */
export interface SessionLogLike {
  events?: readonly unknown[]
  /** Creation header; carries the agent preset the session started under. */
  header?: { agentPreset?: unknown }
}

/**
 * Structural view of a LIVE host session that can take catalog appends. The
 * host's `Session.append` validates the payload before committing; an older
 * host without the `subagent/catalog` event accepts the method but throws,
 * which the helper below treats as "not supported".
 */
export interface SessionCatalogLike extends SessionLogLike {
  append?: (type: string, data: Record<string, unknown>) => unknown
}

/**
 * Record one ACP-side worker in the host's parent-owned subagent catalog as an
 * EXTERNAL execution. Display-only: external entries have no child session, no
 * activity/timing and no continuation, and `list_agents` omits them. The
 * catalog is append-only, so a replayed/resumed dispatch must never add the
 * same `childId` twice. Returns whether a new fact was appended.
 */
export function appendExternalSubagentCatalog(
  session: SessionCatalogLike | undefined,
  childId: string,
  label: string,
  now = Date.now(),
): boolean {
  if (childId === '' || session?.append === undefined) return false
  const events = session.events
  if (Array.isArray(events)) {
    for (let index = events.length - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) {
      const event = events[index] as { type?: unknown; data?: { childId?: unknown } } | undefined
      if (event?.type === 'subagent/catalog' && event.data?.childId === childId) return false
    }
  }
  try {
    session.append('subagent/catalog', {
      version: 2,
      childId,
      childCreatedAt: now,
      mode: 'external',
      label,
    })
    return true
  } catch {
    return false
  }
}

/**
 * The agent preset a session actually runs.
 *
 * Mirrors `resolveSessionPreset` from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-presets`
 * structurally (no dependency): the newest `agent-preset/selected` log event
 * wins over the creation-time header, because a blank session may be recomposed
 * and the header is by design a frozen creation fact.
 *
 * This is how the host half knows a chat session is in ACP mode: the mode IS an
 * agent preset, so reading it back from the session log is the only honest
 * source — a marker we set ourselves could drift from what the roster mounted.
 */
export function sessionAgentPreset(session: SessionLogLike | undefined): string | undefined {
  const events = session?.events
  if (Array.isArray(events)) {
    for (let index = events.length - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) {
